findings.description: Hudson Pacific Properties completed the sale of its office complex at 875 and 899 Howard Street — one building on one parcel, per EAS — for $65.5 million, roughly $230 per square foot across 284,000 square feet. The 899 portion, the former Burlington Coat Factory site, was 100% vacant and in shell condition at sale; the 875 portion was 31.9% occupied, after a tech company had leased roughly 30,000–33,000 square feet there before departing in October 2022. Hudson Pacific had bought the complex in 2007 for $46 million and later converted retail space to office use; the buyer was not disclosed.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Hudson Pacific Dumps Nearly Empty SoMa Office Complex for $65.5 Million,” 26 September 2026

raw.text: Hudson Pacific Properties has completed the sale of its largely vacant office complex at 875 and 899 Howard St. for $65.5 million.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 899 HOWARD ST → parcel 3733079; sf-parcels has blklot 3733079 active, 235–235 05TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1920. EAS puts 861, 875, 881, 899 HOWARD ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 861. 875 HOWARD ST resolves to the same parcel, so the two article findings for this sale are recorded as one.

publish.note: Duplicate: this sale is already on the page, entry source the-registry-2026-09-25 (“Hudson Pacific Sells 284,000 SQFT 875-899 Howard in San Francisco for $65.5MM”, The Registry, 25 September 2026). This story sharpens the fact — each building’s individual occupancy percentage and former tenant, and the 2007 purchase history — recorded in `extra` above, but the event is not written a second time onto the timeline.

findings.description: Two Jack's Nik's Place, a restaurant that had operated at 401 Haight Street for 45 years after opening in 1977 and earning San Francisco Legacy Business status in 2016, closed on 14 July 2022. Passages, a wine bar and bistro, is slated to open in the space, with an expected opening in March 2027; the storefront retains a Type 1 hood commercial kitchen and a basement prep area.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Wine Bar Passages Set To Fill Lower Haight Corner Left By Two Jack's Closure,” 26 September 2026
